decks.name: baseline
decks.labelSource: official: No Game Changer, two-card infinite, mass land denial or extra turns: Core is the landing point ("The power level of the average modern-day preconstructed deck sits here").

decks.name: gc-1
decks.labelSource: official: Core: "No cards from the Game Changers list." Upgraded: "Up to three cards from the Game Changers list."

decks.name: gc-3
decks.labelSource: official: Upgraded allows up to three Game Changers.

decks.name: gc-4
decks.labelSource: official: A fourth Game Changer is over Upgraded's limit; Optimized has none.

decks.name: gc-mdfc-full-name
decks.labelSource: official: Tergrid is on the list; a deck names it by its full Scryfall name, as every card source in the app does.

decks.name: mld-armageddon
decks.labelSource: official: "You should not expect to see these cards [mass land denial] anywhere in Brackets 1-3."

decks.name: mld-ravages
decks.labelSource: official: Mass land denial is excluded from Brackets 1-3.

decks.name: extra-turns-2
decks.labelSource: official: Core: "Extra-turn cards should only appear in low quantities and are not intended to be chained in succession or looped."

decks.name: extra-turns-3
decks.labelSource: heuristic: The text gives no count for "low quantities". SpellControl reads three or more as a deliberate extra-turn theme (Bracket 3); an actual chain is a Spellbook combo and floors through the combo rule.

decks.name: extra-turns-loop
decks.labelSource: official: Extra turns "not intended to be chained in succession or looped" through Bracket 3; Time Sieve + Thorin is a two-card infinite-turns lock Commander Spellbook rates Ruthless.

decks.name: combo-2card-ruthless
decks.labelSource: official: Upgraded: "No intentional early-game two-card infinite combos." Commander Spellbook rates this one Ruthless, its call for combos that belong at Bracket 4 and up.

decks.name: combo-2card-spicy-late
decks.labelSource: official: Core: "No intentional two-card infinite combos." Upgraded allows ones that come together late; Spellbook rates this Spicy and the list has no tutors or fast mana to speed it up.

decks.name: combo-2card-spicy-fast
decks.labelSource: heuristic: The same Spicy combo with six tutors and three fast-mana pieces (none a Game Changer) can come together early, which Upgraded excludes. How much speed counts as early is SpellControl's acceleration model.

decks.name: combo-2card-core-rated
decks.labelSource: official: The brackets leave each combo's call to classification; Commander Spellbook rates this one Core (fine at Bracket 2), and the floor follows its rating (E382).

decks.name: combo-2card-exhibition-rated
decks.labelSource: official: Commander Spellbook rates Approach of the Second Sun + Farsight Ritual Exhibition: no floor.

decks.name: combo-commander
decks.url: SpellControl ruling of 2026-09-23 (project memory: bracket precon calibration): commander plus at most two other cards floors at Bracket 4, matching Commander Spellbook's Ruthless rating
decks.labelSource: heuristic: The commander is always available, so the deck only has to draw one card; Commander Spellbook rates such combos Ruthless.

decks.name: combo-3card-lone
decks.labelSource: official: The brackets restrict two-card infinite combos; a lone three-card line sets no floor (it adds combo-engine points to the power signal).

decks.name: combo-3card-two-lines
decks.labelSource: heuristic: Two independent complete three-card infinites count as one two-card line (MULTI_CARD_COMBO_WEIGHT), which Core excludes.

decks.name: stax-3
decks.labelSource: heuristic: Not in the bracket text. Three lock pieces read as a deliberate resource-denial plan (SpellControl rule).

decks.name: stax-5
decks.labelSource: heuristic: Five lock pieces lock opponents out like land denial (SpellControl rule).
